title: RC-06 malformed risk settings switch the risk limits off: a non-numeric MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE, DAILY_LOSS_PCT, SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS, MAX_POSITION_SIZE or per-chain max capital parses to NaN and every comparison against it is false; the same defaults are written out at four sites with three different parsers

evidence.note: loadRiskConfig parses once at import with parseInt/parseFloat and `|| default`; no isNaN or range check
every check is a plain > / >= / <= / < comparison; with a NaN operand each one is false, so the refusing branch never runs
the only re-validation: MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS via Number() + Number.isInteger, fail-closed at boot
contrast: block-age tolerance is explicitly rejected on NaN or <= 0 with log.fatal (fail-closed), as are the tax bps (:701-714) and the anti-rug overlays (:730-865)
snipe amount, max capital and min liquidity pass through with || and no validation
sibling site (API slice): the dashboard parses the same keys again with the same literals
sibling site (API slice): raw strings with the same defaults
definition sites: riskManager.ts:28-32, preflight.ts:185, api/routes/risk.ts:80-82, api/routes/chains.ts:88-90, plus the descriptions in config.ts:57-61 and .env.example:58-63; no other parser

sibling_sites_checked: Every env parser in the seven DB slice files is classified site by site in sub_claims (16 entries). Fail-open sites: riskManager.ts:29 MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE, :30 DAILY_LOSS_PCT (non-numeric), :31 SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS, :32 MAX_POSITION_SIZE (non-numeric), the per-chain <PREFIX>_MAX_CAPITAL (chainRegistry.ts:664 -> riskManager.ts:96), <PREFIX>_BLOCK_AGE_TOLERANCE_SEC only for Infinity, and config.ts:300-302 TRAILING_* (consumer in EXIT). Fail-closed sites: MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS (preflight re-parse at boot), <PREFIX>_SNIPE_AMOUNT and <PREFIX>_GAS_BUFFER (preflight parseEther), block age NaN/<=0 (chainRegistry.ts:676), tax bps (:701-714), anti-rug overlays (:730-865), LIVE_EXECUTE strict match, LOG_LEVEL / NETWORK / ENABLED_CHAINS. Default (bad value silently replaced): EXIT_GATE_SELL_GAS_BUFFER, DELIBERATE_BUY_GAS_BUFFER, STALE_*, STOP_LOSS_PCT, SIGINT_GRACE_MS (bot.ts:2305-2307, BUY row TH-BUY-15). Display-only: api/routes/risk.ts:80-82 and chains.ts:88-90 (API slice owns those files). Parsers outside this slice are owned by their slices (reconciliation.ts, exitEngine.ts, bot.ts).
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion. A typo or unit in .env (for example MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE=10ETH works by luck, MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE=ten does not) turns off the exposure cap, the daily-loss breaker, the cooldown or the per-trade cap with no log line and no boot refusal; the dashboard then shows NaN or the raw text. The research claim is narrowed site by site: MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS does NOT fail open in the running system because preflight re-parses it strictly and refuses boot, and the chain-registry parsers named in the review (block age, tax bps, anti-rug overlays) reject bad values with log.fatal. The fail-open set is the four riskManager keys other than MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS plus the per-chain max capital.
recommendation: One typed settings module that parses every risk and money key once at boot, refuses to start on a non-numeric, non-finite or out-of-range value (the chainRegistry.ts:676 pattern), and is the only source for riskManager, preflight and the dashboard routes. Which defaults and which strictness is card OD-25 (option align-one-parser). Phase 24; nothing is changed in Phase 22.

At boot preflight checkWalletBalance re-parses with Number() + Number.isInteger and returns passed:false for any of these, and preflight() exits FATAL before any chain context exists (bot.ts:1710), so the combined system refuses to start
